subject: HITNet kickoff - real-time stereo depth as a platform capability
body:
Team,

Kicking off the HITNet track. Goal: turn our open-source HITNet release (hierarchical iterative tile refinement for real-time stereo matching) into a supported depth-estimation capability other portfolios can call, instead of everyone hand-rolling stereo.

Scope for this window: stand up evaluation on the three dataset families we ship models for - FlyingThings (max disparity 320, cleanpass and finalpass), Middlebury at half resolution (160/288/400 disparity variants), and ETH3D (128). Milestones: eval harness reproducing PSM EPE by mid-April, latency characterization in May, go/no-go on a real-time serving demo at the June Launch Review Board.

One heads-up from the repo: datasets have to be downloaded manually and scripts pointed at the right locations, so Rosa - can you own a one-time ingest so the rest of the team isn't fighting paths?

Deshawn will follow up on staffing and compute.

Dmitri
